negative_reviews.author: Natalie Louise Felton
negative_reviews.text:
Unfortunately, we left feeling quite disappointed with our experience at Maki and ramen, particularly as we had chosen to come here to celebrate our anniversary and were looking forward to it.

We were seated in what felt like a tucked-away corner and unfortunately seemed to be forgotten about. It took around 25 minutes for anyone to come over and serve us, despite approximately 5  members of staff walking past us during that time.

Unfortunately, the service didn’t improve after that. It then took a further 30 minutes for us to receive our drinks, and we had to remind the staff twice that we had actually ordered them even getting our food before our drinks...

We completely understand that restaurants can get busy, especially as this is new to west Quay but it was difficult to understand how our table could be overlooked for so long when there were so many staff members walking passed us.

To make matters worse, when we eventually asked for the bill, we felt like we were suddenly being hovered over by staff, which made the experience feel even more uncomfortable. It was a very different level of attention compared with when we were waiting to be served.

We had been looking forward to having a nice day together. Unfortunately, feeling like we had been shoved into a corner and forgotten about for such a significant part of the meal really put a dampener on what was supposed to be a special occasion.

Hopefully this was just an off day, but based on our experience, the service really needs some attention. We expected a much more attentive and welcoming experience, especially when celebrating something special.

I wouldn’t rush back here.
